jsonld_raw.name: (155 G) BERGAMOT & SANDALWOOD SCENTED CANDLE
jsonld_raw.description:
Scented candle made of vegetable wax.


Bergamot & Sandalwood | A fragrance that offers a delicious journey, from bright and refreshing top notes to an exuberant floral heart, finishing in a warm and welcoming base, which makes it a sophisticated proposal and a unique experience.

 
Notes:
Top notes: bergamot, rose, rhubarb, grapefruit.
Heart notes: lily of the valley, rose, geranium, jasmine.
Base notes: musk, cedar.
